newsitem.title: ESTONIA: RAKVERE TO DECREASE ITS SHARE CAPITAL.
newsitem.headline: RAKVERE TO DECREASE ITS SHARE CAPITAL.

text.p: Rakvere meat plant will decrease its share capital from March 24 by a rate of one share for ten shares, the company said in a statement on Friday.
The company said according to its extraordinary general meeting the company will reduce the number of shares on March 24.
The reduction will affect 41.9 million kroons worth of shares. The new share capital will be 377.2 million kroons.
The share reduction was organised to match the company's net assets and to carry it onto the register of companies, the statement said.
